provenance.scope: the walk's end: the choice beside the look up and the plate it opens, words by key
provenance.learn_word: ending.learn.word is the owner's own wording for the choice, EN and DE, and is fixed.
provenance.destination: The choice opens Leonardo's mode choice in the library (`/app?figure=leonardo-da-vinci&lang=<lang>`), not a conversation: no question rides the address.
provenance.placeholders: ending.plate.title, ending.plate.line and ending.plate.go still carry the plate's earlier words (the door's title, the farewell question, the door's way in). They describe a conversation the new destination no longer opens and wait for written words. Every other sentence of the plate (the library line, the Echo's disclosure, the terms) is the frame's own and stays as it is.

line.de: Ich bin gerade durch dein ganzes Leben gegangen. Was soll ich mitnehmen?
